Subject: Exec satellite room sightlines, telecast patch, and vendor credentialing

Erica —

Thanks again for the quick walkthrough yesterday. We're narrowing final venue choices and I need three concrete confirmations from Grand Plaza Ops before we lock:

1) Sightlines: can you confirm the attached site-sightlines-20270812.pdf reflects the final floor plan for the Oxley Suite (satellite room) and the sightline clearance to the main stage camera positions? We want to be sure remote panelists on camera have unobstructed LOS for at least two robotic PTZs.

2) Telecast patching: our broadcast vendor needs an AES67 + 2x XLR camera return + four IFB channels to the satellite room. Is there an SMPTE patch in the same rack as the main stage router, and do you have a spare 1U patch bay we can reserve during load-in? Explicit pinout confirmation appreciated.

3) Vendor credentialing & shuttle windows: attached vendor-credential-form.docx is our standard; what's your process for on-site vendor wristbands vs. printed badges? Also share shuttle-timetable.csv with recommended load/unload windows to align with our transport plan from the airport.

We're aiming to publish the final logistics package to Halcyon's Ops by COB Monday so Tom can sign off. If you can reply with short bullets and any required vendor rates (OT, after-hours rack access), that would help.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman

Hi Naomi / team —

Thanks for the notes and for sharing the documents. Quick answers inline: 

1) Sightlines: Confirmed. The attached PDF is the updated sightline export from our CAD team (labels: A/B/C camera zones). Oxley Suite has two clear sightline corridors to camera zones A & B; we recommend PTZ mounting at 7.5ft for unobstructed heads-up on the east aisle. Note: there's a fixed pillar at grid E4 — see callout on page 2; crew suggested slight stage camera offset to compensate.

2) Telecast patching: There is an SMPTE feed in Rack 4 adjacent to the main stage router (RU 12). We can reserve 1U in Rack 4 for the weekend; we'll pre-wire an AES67 stream out of the house codec (multicast address provided on request). IFB: we can provision 4 IFB channels over SMPTE with XLR returns. Overtime for late patching applies after 22:00 at +35% hourly.

3) Vendor credentialing & shuttle windows: Our process is two-tier — printed adhesive badges for temporary vendors and RFID wristbands for long-term crew (48+ hours). For your broadcast vendors we recommend printed badges + escorted access to the broadcast compound; full background check is available for overnight vendors (48-hour turnaround). Shuttle windows attached: we suggest two VIP courier windows at 07:30–08:30 and 15:30–16:30 to avoid valet peak. 

Attachments: site-sightlines-20270812.pdf (updated with RU labels), shuttle-timetable.csv (preferred windows).

If you want, we can set a 20-minute tech call tomorrow at 10:00 to run the exact pinout with your broadcast engineer.

— Erica Wong
